body:
I am working on a solution which checks if 'animation' was set as a property and if not, default to the AnimatedSprite3D's selected animation and plan on submitting a merge request for this.  
The fix is simple but in an unfamiliar area of the engine and I'm checking with the engine chat for advice before creating the merge request.

The problem is that the AnimationTrackEditor cannot retrieve the animation needed to create a preview for the frame property track because the value of the animation property track cannot be obtained. If there is a key at time 0, this problem does not occur. > default to the AnimatedSprite3D's selected animation This approach is not recommended. Since if the first keyframe of an animation does not exist at time 0, the actual animation played may change depending on the Deterministic option or UpdateMode. One workaround might be to retrieve the currently playing animation from the AnimatedSprite3D as you said. However, since the AnimationPlayer does not guarantee that the animation can be retrieved from the AnimatedSprite3D, this is not a good solution. So suggested way is that to simply print a warning like "Animation may change depending on the Sprite state at runtime ." using `WARN_PRINT_ONCE`, or use `WARN_PRINT` instead of error and allow the warning to be disabled via project settings (see also https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/86608). At this point, the key preview will likely revert to its default diamond shape.
